[12]

FLUTE: Fast and Secure Lookup Table Evaluations.

Brüggemann, Hundt, Schneider, Ajith Suresh, Yalame

IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy 2023

narrative.overview: The site is a quiet place to read about one researcher's work. The papers carry the page. Entries are set in a book serif on a pale cool ground, the interface is set in Inter and kept small, and a single indigo accent marks what you can act on.
keyCharacteristics: Serif for reading (titles, authors, venues). Sans for tools (nav, filters, chips, badges).
One accent, indigo, on actions and the active state.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines and rules.
Dense but breathable: tight within an entry, generous between years.
Dark site bar on every standalone page as the constant frame.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Indigo marks actions and the active state only. It is never decoration, and it does not fill large areas on reading pages.

rules.name: The Quiet Ink Floor Rule
rules.body: Body-size text on Paper is #475569 or darker. #64748b is for small, non-essential numerals only.

rules.name: The Serif-Reads, Sans-Acts Rule
rules.body: If it is something the visitor reads as content, it is serif. If it is something they operate or scan as metadata, it is Inter.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional or content text is smaller than 11px.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No surface casts a shadow at rest. Shadows are a response to hover, never decoration, and never coloured.

dos: Do set content in Source Serif 4 and controls in Inter.
Do keep indigo for actions and the active state.
Do use #4f46e5, not #6366f1, behind white text.
Do keep text on Paper at #475569 or darker for body size.
Do give every link its paper's title as its accessible name.
Do offset anchor targets by 88px for the sticky bar.
donts: Don't use shadows at rest, coloured glows, or gradient text on reading pages.
Don't put a coloured border on one side of a rounded card.
Don't type publication counts or years into the HTML. They come from data/publications.json.
Don't touch the Scholar anchor and pf-stat-num span in portfolio.html. The weekly citation job rewrites them by regex.
